title: Eat 3 Carrots a Day: Your Palms Turn Orange First 🥕 #shorts
description:
Max eats three carrots a day for the viral "carrot tan" and we follow the orange pigment, beta-carotene, from his stomach into his blood, his fat, and out through sweat and skin oil.
The weird part: palms and soles turn orange first while the whites of the eyes stay white, and the glow gives you basically no sun protection.
Would you try the carrot tan? Tell us in the comments 👇
